name: patient_has_capacity_to_give_informed_consent_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the capacity to give informed consent.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the capacity to give informed consent.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the capacity to give informed consent.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the capacity to give informed consent.

name: patient_has_finding_of_partial_anterior_cerebral_circulation_infarction_now

when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of partial anterior cerebral circulation infarction.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of partial anterior cerebral circulation infarction.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of partial anterior cerebral circulation infarction.

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of transient cerebral ischemia.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of transient cerebral ischemia.

name: patient_stenosis_of_carotid_artery_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric percentage representing the patient's current degree of carotid artery stenosis.
when_unknown: Set to null if no current measurement of carotid artery stenosis is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured percentage value if a current measurement of carotid artery stenosis is available.

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently lacking capacity.

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have an allergy to contrast media (contrast agent).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has an allergy to contrast media (contrast agent).

name: patient_has_finding_of_disability_severe_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a significant (severe) disability.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a significant (severe) disability.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a significant (severe) disability.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a significant (severe) disability.

name: patient_has_finding_of_disability_severe_now@@participation_would_cause_stress
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a significant (severe) disability and participation would cause stress.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a significant (severe) disability and participation would cause stress due to this disability.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a significant (severe) disability but participation would not cause stress, or if the patient does not have a significant (severe) disability.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether participation would cause stress due to the patient's significant (severe) disability.
